title: Split Filter Controller robustness harness
description: Refactor scripts/verify-filter-controller-robustness.php into smaller assertion groups or helpers without weakening coverage.
objective: Keep the robustness harness maintainable as Filter Controller verification grows.
expected_outputs: Harness helpers or grouped assertion modules
Clear place for future Filter Controller checks
acceptance_criteria: No existing robustness assertion is removed.
The WP-CLI eval-file entrypoint remains usable.
Each helper/module stays below the plugin line budget.
verification: php scripts/verify-line-budget.php --strict passes or reports only tracked transition debt.

budgets.context_budget: robustness harness and related test specs

risks: Splitting the harness can hide failures if result aggregation changes.
WordPress eval-file compatibility can break if helper loading assumes CLI paths incorrectly.
Removing assertions by accident would make later refactors less safe.
